definitions.name: U2D.RLE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 'RLR' BIND RLR 0 GET RLR LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric V -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values, in order

definitions.name: U2D.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND UV UV G0D.SHIFT SUB 1 [ 'UE' BIND 'UA' BIND UA 1 ADD 1 UE 0 GT SELECT ] SCAN 1 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: numeric V -> length of its longest stretch of adjacent strictly increasing values (a single value counts 1)

definitions.name: U2D.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS [ 'MK' BIND MT MK GET 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT ] FILTER 0 GET
definitions.note: V -> the value occurring in more than half of the positions, or NIL when none does

definitions.name: U2D.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ G0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer N -> ascending Vector of the primes <= N (empty when none)

definitions.name: U2D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND 0 5 RANGE [ 'BK' BIND 2 BK POW BN GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 SUB 0 RANGE [ 'BJ' BIND BN 2 BJ POW DIV FLOOR 'BQ' BIND BQ BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB ] MAP STR JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 String of '0'/'1' without leading zeros

definitions.name: U2D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND 1 150 RANGE CN 0 2 COLLECT [ 'CI' BIND [ 'CC' 'CS' ] BIND CC CC 2 DIV CC 3 MUL 1 ADD CC 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL CC EQ SELECT CC 1 EQ SELECT CS CS 1 ADD CC 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (bounded at 150 iterations, enough for every start below 100)

definitions.name: U2D.DIGROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'DR' BIND DR DR 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer -> its digital root, as 1 + (n-1) mod 9

definitions.name: U2D.FIBIDX
definitions.body: 'FN' BIND 1 20 RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ 'FI' BIND [ 'FA' 'FB' ] BIND FB FA FB ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer N (up to F(20)=6765) -> smallest k with F(k) >= N, where F(1)=F(2)=1

definitions.name: U2D.BDELTA
definitions.body: [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD 'BDR' BIND CHARS [ 'BC' BIND BDR BC GET ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector with 1 per opening bracket and -1 per closing bracket, in order

definitions.name: U2D.BREDUCE
definitions.body: 'RS' BIND 1 7 RANGE RS [ 'RI' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String (up to 14 chars) -> what remains after repeatedly deleting adjacent '()' and '[]' pairs; empty exactly when balanced

definitions.name: U2D.BALPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'PC' BIND 0 PC LENGTH RANGE [ 'PK' BIND PC PK TAKE JOIN U2D.BREDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER -1 GET
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: U2D.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: V -> the same Vector with every NIL element removed, order kept

definitions.name: U2D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'MNV' BIND MNV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD MNV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric V -> its arithmetic mean

definitions.name: U2D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV U2D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FE FE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NIL gaps (at least one present) -> forward-filled V; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: U2D.GAPRUNS
definitions.body: 0 [ 'LE' BIND 'LA' BIND LA 1 ADD 0 LE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: V -> same-length Vector where each lane holds the length of the NIL run ending there (0 at a present lane)

definitions.name: U2D.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'RTV' BIND RTV -1 DROP RTV 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ [ 'RP' 'RC' ] BIND 1 RC RC NIL? SELECT 1 RP RP NIL? SELECT DIV NIL RP NIL? NOT RC NIL? NOT AND SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: V -> Vector one shorter of each element divided by its predecessor; NIL where either is NIL

definitions.name: U2D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SCV' BIND SCV U2D.PRESENT SORT -1 GET 'SM' BIND SCV [ 'SE' BIND 1 SE SE NIL? SELECT SM DIV NIL SE NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: V with NIL gaps -> each present element divided by the largest present element; NILs stay NIL

definitions.name: U2D.PRICED
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Vector of the order Records that carry a price

definitions.name: U2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: U2D.PRICED [ 'ORD' BIND ORD 'qty' GET ORD 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total of qty times price over the priced orders

definitions.name: U2D.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'OO' BIND OO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'QG' BIND QG KEYS QG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record from each sku to the sum of its qty, skus in order of first appearance

definitions.name: U2D.TITLE
definitions.body: LOWER G0D.WORDS [ CHARS 'TC' BIND TC 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT TC 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN ] MAP G0A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: messy String of words -> the words title-cased (first letter upper, rest lower), joined by single spaces

solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' GET ] MAP U2D.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: U2D.TITLE
